paragraphs.text:
Your mind reels as you see all the areas you could study. Three 
in particular seem of interest: 
• For Polar Studies, go to 163.
• For Pacific isles, go to 119.
• For Germany, go to 88. 
You may select only two areas per visit, but you may leave the 
library and return the same day for additional visits. Each area 
of study takes two hours to explore. When you wish, return to 
74, or go to any New York Location. 
(74, 119, 163)
